website.note: No dedicated /pipeline page. Corporate site lists three device platforms: nPulse Vybrance Percutaneous Ablation System (510(k)-cleared, March 2024), nsPFA Cardiac Surgery Ablation System (IDE, FDA Breakthrough Device), and nsPFA 360 Catheter Endocardial Ablation System (IDE approved Dec 2025).

ctgov.note: All 14 sponsored studies registered as Phase=NA (medical-device studies). No drug Phase 1/2/3 trials. Active recruiting device studies (NCT07287176 PRECISE BTN Vybrance percutaneous, NCT06355063 and NCT06959121 nsPFA Cardiac Surgical Clamp, NCT07018596 and NCT06696170 nsPFA 360 Cardiac Catheter) are pivotal/feasibility device trials, not drug Phase 1-3.

commercial_product.category: Medical devices (Nanosecond Pulsed Field Ablation - nsPFA energy platform)
marketed_platforms: nPulse Vybrance Percutaneous Electrode System (FDA 510(k) clearance March 2024 and August 2024 for soft-tissue ablation in percutaneous and intraoperative surgical procedures; commercial limited market release for benign thyroid nodule ablation)
nPulse Console (FDA 510(k) cleared February 2021 for dermatologic ablation/resurfacing; CE mark January 2021; commercial focus shifted away from dermatology in 2022)

investigational_devices.device: nPulse Vybrance Percutaneous Electrode System (PRECISE BTN)
investigational_devices.indication: Benign thyroid nodule soft-tissue ablation - post-market clinical evidence study
investigational_devices.milestones: Initiated September 2025; up to 50 patients at up to 4 sites; enrollment expected to complete within months.

investigational_devices.device: nsPFA Cardiac Surgical Clamp (nPulse Cardiac Surgery System)
investigational_devices.study_status: IDE-approved pivotal trial, RECRUITING (first patient enrolled Sept 2025); first-in-human feasibility study completed >50 patients in EU
investigational_devices.milestones: FDA Breakthrough Device Designation July 2024; enrolled in FDA TAP program; pivotal IDE up to 136 patients at up to 20 sites; PMA pathway to commercialization.

investigational_devices.device: nsPFA 360 Cardiac Catheter (nPulse Cardiac Catheter System)
investigational_devices.indication: Recurrent drug-resistant symptomatic paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
investigational_devices.study_status: IDE approved December 2025; site qualification underway. EU first-in-human study has treated >165 patients (96% procedural success at 1 year per Feb 2026 AF Symposium presentation).
investigational_devices.milestones: Pivotal IDE planned to enroll up to 155 patients at up to 30 sites including 3 ex-US; PMA pathway.

commercial_product.regulatory_status: Two FDA 510(k) clearances (Vybrance percutaneous electrode and nPulse Console for dermatology). Two pivotal IDE-stage cardiac PFA programs targeting PMA approval.

excluded_preclinical: Endoscopic, gynecologic, gastroenterologic, otolaryngologic applicators (preclinical only)
excluded_legacy_terminated: NCT04249115 - Nano-Pulse Stimulation Seborrheic Keratosis Optimization (TERMINATED)
NCT04253418 - Nano-Pulse Stimulation Sebaceous Hyperplasia Optimization (TERMINATED)
NCT04539886, NCT04738734, NCT04554394, NCT04918381, NCT06117085, NCT03612570, NCT03846531 - completed dermatology and feasibility studies
no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Pulse Biosciences is a pure-play medical device (energy-ablation) company. It does not develop drugs - all programs are Class II/III medical devices regulated via 510(k), de novo, IDE/PMA pathways. ClinicalTrials.gov registers all 14 of its sponsored studies as Phase=NA (device studies). Active pivotal/IDE clinical programs (Vybrance PRECISE BTN, nsPFA Cardiac Surgical Clamp, nsPFA 360 Cardiac Catheter) are documented under commercial_product.investigational_devices.
